name: @lumenize/rpc-stub-disposability
description: Experiment: is a Workers RPC stub (DO / service / RpcTarget / facet) disposable (Symbol.dispose)? Resolves H1 (local-pointer, never disposable) vs H2 (cloudflare:test strips it) across pool-workers / wrangler dev / deployed.
//: NOT listed in the root package.json `workspaces` (unlike other experiments). Deliberate: this experiment pins the LATEST wrangler/vitest, and the monorepo packages use `wrangler: ^4.86.0` which would hoist our newer 4.111 across the whole repo. Standalone `npm install` inside this dir keeps the newer toolchain isolated. Run: `cd experiments/rpc-stub-disposability && npm install`.
